**[id 200]** The passage states that "Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script". (Answer: B)
**[id 201]** The passage states King Sejong "originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum". This means Hunmin Jeongeum was the original name of what is now known as Hangeul. (Answer: B)
**[id 202]** The passage states that "Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy." (Answer: D)
**[id 203]** The passage states that the Moon's crust is "thicker under the highlands." (Answer: C)
**[id 204]** The passage calls the Amazon River the "second longest", "biggest", and "widest". It does not say it is the "longest river" on Earth. (Answer: C)
**[id 205]** The passage states that "Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector", which is the largest proportion compared to industry (nearly a quarter), agriculture (a fifth), and oil (one percent). (Answer: A)
**[id 206]** The passage notes that stars give off light and heat due to energy from merged hydrogen atoms, and that scientists want to build a reactor to "make energy in the same way". (Answer: D)
**[id 207]** The passage clearly states, "Italy's main goals were African countries," meaning capturing them. (Answer: A)
